seniority.evidence: Career-changer from law to UX design. Only the two recent UX roles (contract designer at Bright Pixel Studio since March 2025, and prior part-time intern at Neighbourhood Digital Sept 2024-Feb 2025) are relevant to the target UX/UI Designer position. The extensive legal career (2014-2020) and career break (2021-2024) are not relevant to UX design practice. Combined relevant experience totals approximately 1.5-1.7 years in the UX field, clearly placing candidate at Junior level for a UX/UI Designer role despite a longer overall career arc.

style_patterns.sentence_structure: Action verb + object + outcome or context; occasional prepositional phrase extensions
style_patterns.voice_descriptor: Professional achievement-led bullets with strong quantification and ownership framing in UX roles; active voice throughout. CV demonstrates confident, metric-backed presentation of recent work. Cover letter is conversational, self-aware, and authentically personal — balances candor with professionalism.
writing_strengths: Strong quantification of outcomes (e.g. '34% to 71%', '40+ user interviews', '$50M–$500M+')
Clear progression narrative across career transition
Effective use of concrete project examples
writing_weaknesses: Some bullets extend to wordy lengths (18-word average)
Minor inconsistencies in formatting (dashes, parenthetical usage)
Cover letter includes some hedging/self-deprecating language
